opening.argument: Paid packages are tied directly to tokens, and the presenter urges viewers to mine as many coins as possible. He describes a two-year window in which participants can create wealth, then explains that commissions come from people buying educational packages and becoming miners. He also says that building a team has basically no limits to what one can make. These claims place paid mining and recruitment at the center of the opportunity: viewers are encouraged to buy in, recruit others, and expect wealth creation, not simply learn about cryptocurrency. The presentation thus promotes a high-return paid mining and recruitment opportunity, while the stated window adds urgency.
